source.title: Technical Data - Mobile crane LTM 1070-4.2 [m/t] (liebherr.com download)

notes: Source table has 12 boom lengths (11, 14.6, 18.2, 21.8, 25.4, 28.9, 32.5, 36.1, 39.7, 43.3, 46.9, 50 m); 36.1 m and 43.3 m omitted here to keep 10 columns. The 11 m boom has an extra 'over rear' (*) sub-column (70 t at 2.5 m, 61.3 t at 3 m ...) which is NOT included; values here are the 360° sub-column (max 51 t at 3 m). 2.5 m radius row dropped because only the over-rear column has a value. Chart values are gross: per remark 5 (p.29) the weight of hook block and hooks is part of the load and must be deducted. Outrigger span from dimension drawing p.3: 6300 mm transverse (VarioBase allows 2320-6300) x 7991 mm longitudinal. maxOutriggerForce 520 kN (53 t) from p.9 (the other figure listed is 320 kN/33 t). operatingWeight_t = 40 t on-road config with 3.8 t counterweight and 10 t axle loads (p.10); 48 t with 10.7 t counterweight at 12 t axle loads; 54 t jobsite with 14.5 t. Max hook height not taken: cover shows 65 m (likely with jib), main-boom value not stated as a single number. A 10.7 t counterweight table also exists on p.13. DIMS (added 2026-09-24 from the dimension drawing p.3 of the same source PDF): overallLength_m = carrier length (bottom dimension chain); axle positions and slew centre are cumulative sums of that chain from the carrier front; height = column A, width = column B for standard 385/95 R 25 (14.00 R 25) tyres. wheelDiameter_m is a nominal value computed from the tyre designation (not on the drawing). Boom pivot height/offset not dimensioned (null). Slew centre 275 mm behind axle 3. Tail radius R = 3460 mm; overall length 12.507 m (boom head to rear), 3.975 m slew-to-rearmost incl. a lightly drawn rear item. Dimension reference corrected: the datasheet's bottom dimension chain starts at the front of the boom head (transport position, boom overhanging the cab), not at the carrier front bumper. overallLength_m is now the carrier length (front bumper to rear) and axlePositions_m / slewCentreFromFront_m are measured from the carrier front bumper; the boom head overhang ahead of the bumper is stored as boomOverhangFront_m = 2.287 m (overall transport length incl. boom = 12.4 m). Evidence (dimensions drawing p.3): bottom chain 2287 | 2784 | 1650 | 2050 | 1650 | 1979 = 12400 with separate 10113 carrier dimension; slew centre 275 behind 3rd axle.
